reason: Cold naengmyeon with kudzu noodles is something I would go out of my way for after a hot day at Ala Moana, and Set B at $45.95 shared between my wife and me is acceptable for one dinner. I would go once on this trip, not more, because Honolulu prices already hurt.
objection: $18.95 for a bowl of cold noodles, then tax and tip on top, is nearly double what I pay in Japan, and kalbi at $38.95 is too much. If we were five people the automatic 20% would make me pick somewhere else.
